metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Security Property Catalog
metadata.description: Comprehensive catalog of formal security properties with 100% coverage of all nodes and edges in the Program Graph. Each graph element has at least one associated property with formal reachability analysis.

properties.property: The state STATE-USER-IDLE represents an unauthenticated user session where no privileged operations can be initiated without explicit user action.
properties.anti_property: An attacker can force transitions from STATE-USER-IDLE to privileged states without user consent.
properties.reachability_rationale: STATE-USER-IDLE is the initial state for user flows. All outgoing edges require explicit user action (cryptographic signing). No autonomous transitions exist from this state to privileged operations.
properties.notes: Entry point for private transfer initiation.

properties.property: The state STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING accurately reflects ERC20 token ownership verified by on-chain balance queries.
properties.anti_property: An attacker can spoof ownership of underlying tokens without actual on-chain balance.
properties.reachability_rationale: Underlying token ownership is enforced by ERC20 standard. The LiquidityManager.wrap() function calls safeTransferFrom which reverts if sender lacks sufficient balance.

properties.property: The state STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 is only reachable through valid wrap completion or teleport receipt, ensuring zERC20 supply is always backed.
properties.anti_property: A user can reach STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 without providing underlying collateral or valid cryptographic proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: All paths to STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 pass through either ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 (which requires prior liquidity pull) or STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE (which requires valid Groth16 proof verification). No bypass paths exist.
properties.notes: Critical invariant for token supply integrity.

properties.property: The state STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP validates that the wrap request originates from a valid EVM address with non-zero amount.
properties.anti_property: An attacker can submit wrap requests with zero amount or from invalid addresses.
properties.reachability_rationale: LiquidityManager contract validates amount > 0 and sender address is non-zero as Solidity invariants. Zero amount wraps provide no economic incentive.

properties.property: The action ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD computes rewards using IncentiveLib with floor rounding, preventing reward inflation.
properties.anti_property: An attacker can manipulate reward calculations to receive more zERC20 than the incentive curve specifies.
properties.reachability_rationale: IncentiveLib uses immutable parameters (k, T) and deterministic integration. Floor rounding in wrap rewards ensures the protocol never overpays. Calculation is pure function of state.

properties.property: The action ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY atomically transfers underlying tokens before any minting occurs.
properties.anti_property: Minting can occur before underlying tokens are successfully transferred to LiquidityManager.
properties.reachability_rationale: The graph structure enforces ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY before ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20. SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom reverts on failure, preventing execution from reaching mint action.

properties.property: The action ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 can only be executed by LiquidityManager contract with exclusive minting authority.
properties.anti_property: An unauthorized contract or EOA can invoke zERC20 minting.
properties.reachability_rationale: zERC20.mint() is protected by onlyMinter modifier which checks msg.sender against the registered LiquidityManager address. No other paths to minting exist.

properties.property: The state STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE is only reachable after successful underlying transfer AND zERC20 minting in atomic transaction.
properties.anti_property: STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE can be reached with partial execution (transfer without mint or vice versa).
properties.reachability_rationale: Solidity atomicity guarantees: if any operation in wrap() reverts, entire transaction reverts. The Wrapped event in STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE only emits on successful completion.

properties.property: The state STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP validates that user has sufficient zERC20 balance for the requested unwrap amount.
properties.anti_property: An attacker can initiate unwrap with amount exceeding their zERC20 balance.
properties.reachability_rationale: zERC20.burn() checks balance >= amount before burning. ERC20 standard _burn reverts on insufficient balance.

properties.property: The action ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE computes fees using IncentiveLib with ceil rounding, ensuring protocol never undercollects.
properties.anti_property: An attacker can manipulate fee calculations to pay less than the incentive curve specifies.
properties.reachability_rationale: IncentiveLib uses ceiling rounding for fees. Parameters are immutable after deployment. Fee calculation is deterministic pure function.

properties.property: The action ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20 burns tokens before underlying is released, preventing double-withdrawal.
properties.anti_property: Underlying tokens can be released before zERC20 burning is confirmed.
properties.reachability_rationale: Graph structure enforces ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20 before ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING. The burn operation must succeed before transfer proceeds.

properties.property: The action ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING transfers exactly (amount - fee) to the user, with fee retained by protocol.
properties.anti_property: An attacker can receive more underlying than (amount - calculated_fee).
properties.reachability_rationale: Transfer amount is computed from immutable fee calculation. SafeERC20.safeTransfer ensures exact amount transfer or revert.

properties.property: The state STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE guarantees zERC20 was burned AND underlying transferred atomically.
properties.anti_property: STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE is reachable with partial execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: Atomic transaction semantics. Unwrapped event only emits after both burn and transfer succeed.

properties.property: The state STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY correctly prevents unwraps when underlying reserves are insufficient.
properties.anti_property: Unwrap succeeds even when LiquidityManager lacks sufficient underlying token reserves.
properties.reachability_rationale: IncentiveLib.getUnwrapFee checks amount <= underlyingBalance - feeSurplus. If exceeded, reverts with InsufficientLiquidity error.

properties.property: The state STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER validates sender has sufficient balance before processing transfer.
properties.anti_property: Transfer proceeds with sender having insufficient zERC20 balance.
properties.reachability_rationale: OpenZeppelin ERC20 _transfer checks balance >= amount before any state modification.

properties.property: The action ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE enforces value <= 2^248-1 for BN254 scalar field compatibility.
properties.anti_property: Values exceeding 2^248-1 can be recorded in the hash chain, causing ZK proof failures.
properties.reachability_rationale: zERC20._afterTokenTransfer hook checks value <= MAX_VALUE. Reverts with ValueTooLarge error if exceeded. All value-modifying operations pass through this check.

properties.property: The action ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES performs atomic debit/credit with no intermediate states visible.
properties.anti_property: Balance updates can be observed in inconsistent state during transfer.
properties.reachability_rationale: EVM atomicity ensures all storage updates in a transaction are either fully applied or fully reverted.

properties.property: The action ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN appends SHA-256(prevHash || to || value) truncated to 248 bits deterministically.
properties.anti_property: Hash chain updates can be forged or computed inconsistently with the Nova circuits.
properties.reachability_rationale: SHA-256 is collision-resistant. The update formula matches Nova circuit implementation exactly. Hash chain is append-only with no delete capability.

properties.property: The action ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER emits IndexedTransfer with monotonically increasing index.
properties.anti_property: IndexedTransfer events can have non-monotonic or duplicate indices.
properties.reachability_rationale: Index counter uses unchecked increment starting from 0. No arithmetic overflow possible for realistic usage (2^256 transfers). No decrement or reset operations exist.

properties.property: The state STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE guarantees balance update, hash chain update, and event emission all succeeded atomically.
properties.anti_property: Transfer completion with inconsistent state (e.g., event without balance change).
properties.reachability_rationale: EVM atomic transactions ensure all-or-nothing execution. Event emission is part of the same transaction.

properties.property: The state STATE-TRANSFER-REJECTED-VALUE-TOO-LARGE is reached deterministically when value > 2^248-1.
properties.anti_property: Large values can sometimes bypass the value validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Value validation in _afterTokenTransfer uses strict comparison. No conditional bypasses exist.

properties.property: The state STATE-VERIFIER-IDLE represents a clean state where no proof validation is in progress.
properties.anti_property: Verifier can have residual state from previous proof attempts affecting new validations.
properties.reachability_rationale: Each proof validation is stateless with respect to previous validations. Only persistent state is provedTransferRoots and globalTransferRoots mappings.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-RESERVE-HASH-CHAIN creates immutable checkpoint binding between index and hash chain state.
properties.anti_property: Reserved checkpoints can be modified after creation or created for non-existent indices.
properties.reachability_rationale: reservedHashChains[index] is write-once. The function queries current zERC20 state at call time and stores immutably. No update function exists.

properties.property: The state STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED guarantees the HashChainReserved event accurately reflects stored checkpoint.
properties.anti_property: Event data differs from stored checkpoint data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emission uses same values as storage write. Both operations are in same transaction.

properties.property: The state STATE-AWAITING-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROOF requires prior hash chain reservation at the target index.
properties.anti_property: Transfer root proofs can be submitted for indices without reserved checkpoints.
properties.reachability_rationale: proveTransferRoot checks reservedHashChains[index] != empty. Reverts if no checkpoint exists for the claimed index.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF cryptographically verifies IVC proof via IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof().
properties.anti_property: Invalid Nova proofs can pass verification and store fraudulent transfer roots.
properties.reachability_rationale: IRootDecider implements Groth16 on-chain verification using ark-groth16 generated verifier. Soundness of Groth16 ensures computational infeasibility of forging proofs.

properties.property: The state STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED is only reachable through successful cryptographic proof verification.
properties.anti_property: Transfer roots can be stored without valid cryptographic proofs.
properties.reachability_rationale: All paths to STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED pass through ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF. No administrative bypass exists.

properties.property: The state STATE-EMERGENCY-TRIGGERED is reached only when divergent proofs for same index are detected.
properties.anti_property: Emergency can be triggered maliciously without actual proof divergence.
properties.reachability_rationale: Emergency triggers only when provedTransferRoots[index] != 0 AND newRoot != existingRoot. Both conditions require valid proofs. Soundness ensures this indicates actual protocol breach.

properties.property: The state STATE-AWAITING-TELEPORT-PROOF enforces that teleport request contains all required parameters.
properties.anti_property: Malformed teleport requests with missing parameters can reach validation logic.
properties.reachability_rationale: Solidity function signature enforces parameter presence. ABI encoding ensures complete parameter transmission.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE checks root existence in provedTransferRoots or globalTransferRoots.
properties.anti_property: Arbitrary roots not in the proven set can be used for teleports.
properties.reachability_rationale: The verification checks provedTransferRoots[root.index] == root.value for local, or globalTransferRoots[aggSeq] for global. Unknown roots cause revert.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH ensures proof's recipientHash matches msg.sender derived hash.
properties.anti_property: User A can claim tokens intended for User B by submitting B's proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: recipientHash is computed as Poseidon(chain_id, address, tweak). Address component must match msg.sender. Collision resistance prevents forging matching hash.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY enforces totalTeleported strictly increasing to prevent double-spend.
properties.anti_property: Same proof can be used multiple times to mint tokens.
properties.reachability_rationale: totalTeleported is updated to proof's newTotal only if newTotal > currentTotal. Replay of same proof fails because newTotal <= currentTotal.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF cryptographically verifies the withdrawal proof (Nova or Groth16).
properties.anti_property: Invalid withdrawal proofs can authorize token minting.
properties.reachability_rationale: Groth16 verification via on-chain verifier contract. Soundness ensures forged proofs are computationally infeasible.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT mints exactly the delta amount specified in the verified proof.
properties.anti_property: Minting amount differs from what the proof authorized.
properties.reachability_rationale: Delta is extracted from verified proof public inputs. zERC20.teleport() is called with this exact value. No modification path exists.

properties.property: The state STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE is only reachable after all four validations pass: root, recipient, monotonicity, proof.
properties.anti_property: Teleport completion with failed validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Graph structure enforces sequential validation. Each validation reverts on failure. Teleport event only emits after successful zERC20.teleport() call.

properties.property: The state STATE-TELEPORT-REJECTED is reached for any validation failure with no tokens minted.
properties.anti_property: Partial minting can occur before reaching rejection state.
properties.reachability_rationale: All validations occur before teleport call. Failure reverts entire transaction. No state changes persist on revert.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-RELAY-ROOT only sends roots that have been cryptographically proven.
properties.anti_property: Unproven roots can be relayed to Hub.
properties.reachability_rationale: relayTransferRoot() reads from provedTransferRoots mapping which only gets populated after successful proof verification.

properties.property: The state STATE-ROOT-RELAYED confirms LayerZero message was successfully submitted.
properties.anti_property: STATE-ROOT-RELAYED reached without successful message submission.
properties.reachability_rationale: _lzSend reverts on failure. State only reached after successful LayerZero submission.

properties.property: The state STATE-HUB-IDLE represents Hub ready to receive cross-chain messages from registered Verifiers only.
properties.anti_property: Hub accepts messages from non-registered sources.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hub._lzReceive validates source EID against registered Verifiers. Invalid EIDs cause revert.

properties.property: The action ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT validates sender EID matches registered Verifier for the claimed token.
properties.anti_property: Roots from unauthorized EIDs can be stored.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hub maintains tokenInfo[tokenIndex].verifierEid mapping. Message sender EID must match registered value.

properties.property: The action ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT updates transferRoots mapping with authenticated new root.
properties.anti_property: Root updates can occur without sender authentication.
properties.reachability_rationale: Update only occurs after EID validation. Storage is atomic.

properties.property: The state STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED emits TransferRootUpdated event matching stored value.
properties.anti_property: Event data diverges from storage.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emission uses same values as storage write in same transaction.

properties.property: The state STATE-AWAITING-BROADCAST allows broadcast only when at least one token root has been updated.
properties.anti_property: Broadcast with empty or unchanged roots.
properties.reachability_rationale: Broadcast can technically be called anytime but produces deterministic result. Empty/unchanged broadcasts waste gas but don't affect security.

properties.property: The action ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION computes PoseidonT3 tree deterministically from current roots.
properties.anti_property: Aggregation result differs from inputs or is non-deterministic.
properties.reachability_rationale: PoseidonT3 is a deterministic hash function. Tree construction is pure function of input roots. Same inputs always produce same output.

properties.property: The action ACTION-HUB-INCREMENT-AGG-SEQ maintains strictly monotonic sequence number for global roots.
properties.anti_property: Sequence numbers can repeat or decrease.
properties.reachability_rationale: aggSeq uses unchecked increment. No decrement or reset functions exist. Overflow infeasible for practical usage.

properties.property: The action ACTION-HUB-BROADCAST-ROOT sends identical global root to all registered Verifiers.
properties.anti_property: Different Verifiers receive different global roots in same broadcast.
properties.reachability_rationale: Broadcast iterates over registered Verifiers sending same message payload. Message construction precedes iteration.

properties.property: The state STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST confirms messages sent to all registered Verifier EIDs.
properties.anti_property: Partial broadcast with some Verifiers not receiving message.
properties.reachability_rationale: LayerZero message submission can fail for individual destinations. However, this is infrastructure failure, not security bypass. Failed Verifiers simply won't have latest global root.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT only stores roots from authorized Hub EID.
properties.anti_property: Global roots from unauthorized sources can be stored.
properties.reachability_rationale: Verifier._lzReceive validates source EID matches configured Hub EID. Invalid sources cause revert.

properties.property: The state STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED enables cross-chain teleports using the saved root.
properties.anti_property: Teleports can use global roots not in globalTransferRoots mapping.
properties.reachability_rationale: Cross-chain teleport validation checks globalTransferRoots[aggSeq]. Only stored roots pass validation.

properties.property: The state STATE-INDEXER-IDLE represents indexer ready to process blockchain events.
properties.anti_property: Indexer in corrupted state affecting proof generation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Indexer is semi-trusted. Corrupted indexer produces invalid Merkle proofs which fail on-chain verification. Security not dependent on indexer integrity.

properties.property: The action ACTION-INDEXER-WATCH-EVENTS monitors IndexedTransfer events from authorized zERC20 contracts.
properties.anti_property: Fake events from unauthorized contracts can be indexed.
properties.reachability_rationale: Even if fake events indexed, resulting Merkle proofs fail on-chain verification against actual hash chain state. On-chain state is authoritative.

properties.property: The action ACTION-INDEXER-BUILD-TREE constructs Merkle tree matching on-chain hash chain structure.
properties.anti_property: Indexer tree diverges from on-chain state.
properties.reachability_rationale: Divergent trees produce proofs that fail on-chain verification. Users can detect and report indexer misbehavior. Economic incentive for correct indexing.

properties.property: The state STATE-INDEXER-TREE-READY indicates Merkle tree is available for proof queries.
properties.anti_property: Partial tree serves incomplete proofs.
properties.reachability_rationale: Incomplete proofs fail ZK circuit witness generation. Users simply retry with complete tree. No security impact.

properties.property: The action ACTION-INDEXER-GENERATE-PROOFS produces Merkle proofs verifiable against on-chain roots.
properties.anti_property: Generated proofs fail on-chain verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: All generated proofs are verified within ZK circuits against on-chain committed roots. Invalid proofs result in rejected ZK proofs.

properties.property: The state STATE-PROVER-IDLE represents prover service ready to accept IVC proof conversion jobs.
properties.anti_property: Prover in state that corrupts proof conversions.
properties.reachability_rationale: Malicious prover cannot forge valid Groth16 proofs due to soundness. Can only fail to produce proofs or produce invalid ones (which fail on-chain verification).

properties.property: The action ACTION-PROVER-RECEIVE-IVC deserializes and locally verifies incoming Nova IVC proofs.
properties.anti_property: Prover accepts invalid IVC proofs for conversion.
properties.reachability_rationale: Even if invalid IVC accepted, resulting Groth16 proof would be invalid and fail on-chain verification. No security impact.

properties.property: The state STATE-JOB-QUEUED maintains job ordering for fair processing.
properties.anti_property: Job queue manipulation allows priority jumping.
properties.reachability_rationale: Queue ordering is availability/fairness concern, not security. Priority manipulation doesn't affect proof validity.

properties.property: The state STATE-JOB-PROCESSING represents active Groth16 computation.
properties.anti_property: Processing state without actual computation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stalled processing affects availability only. Users can retry with different prover service.

properties.property: The action ACTION-PROVER-CONVERT-TO-GROTH16 produces Groth16 proof if and only if IVC is valid.
properties.anti_property: Valid Groth16 proof from invalid IVC input.
properties.reachability_rationale: Groth16 proving circuit enforces IVC validity. Invalid IVC produces invalid Groth16 proof that fails on-chain verification. This is enforced by zkSNARK soundness.

properties.property: The state STATE-JOB-COMPLETED provides Groth16 proof that will pass on-chain verification.
properties.anti_property: Completed job provides invalid proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Groth16 proof soundness ensures validity. Prover uses same verification key as on-chain verifier.

properties.property: The state STATE-JOB-FAILED indicates proof generation failed with no partial outputs.
properties.anti_property: Partial/malformed proof returned on failure.
properties.reachability_rationale: Failed jobs return error status, not proof data. Any returned data is ignored by clients checking status.

properties.property: The state STATE-ADAPTOR-IDLE represents Adaptor ready for cross-chain exit requests.
properties.anti_property: Adaptor in state that misroutes funds.
properties.reachability_rationale: Adaptor is trusted on-chain contract. Routing is determined by user-specified parameters. Contract enforces parameter validation.

properties.property: The action ACTION-ADAPTOR-RECEIVE-UNWRAP-BRIDGE validates user zERC20 balance before proceeding.
properties.anti_property: Bridge initiated without sufficient user balance.
properties.reachability_rationale: Adaptor calls LiquidityManager.unwrap() which checks balance. Insufficient balance causes revert before any bridging.

properties.property: The action ACTION-ADAPTOR-UNWRAP-VIA-LM delegates to LiquidityManager with all unwrap validations.
properties.anti_property: Adaptor bypasses LiquidityManager validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Adaptor calls LiquidityManager.unwrap() which enforces all unwrap security properties. No bypass path exists.

properties.property: The action ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE enforces slippage limits protecting user value.
properties.anti_property: Bridge executes with slippage exceeding user limit.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stargate bridge uses minAmountOut parameter. If destination amount < minAmountOut, bridge reverts or triggers refund.

properties.property: The state STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED confirms cross-chain message sent via Stargate.
properties.anti_property: Bridge initiated without message delivery guarantee.
properties.reachability_rationale: Cross-chain delivery depends on LayerZero liveness. Stargate provides refund mechanism for failed deliveries. Funds not lost on failure.

properties.property: The state STATE-BRIDGE-FAILED triggers refund mechanism returning funds to user.
properties.anti_property: Bridge failure results in lost funds.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stargate implements refund for failed bridges. User can claim refund on source chain. Funds not permanently lost.

properties.property: The action ACTION-USER-GENERATE-STEALTH derives stealth address using PoW with deterministic computation.
properties.anti_property: Stealth address derivation is non-deterministic or forgeable.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stealth address = Baby JubJub scalar multiplication with Poseidon hash. PoW ensures specific secret format. Deterministic for given inputs.

properties.property: The action ACTION-USER-GENERATE-NOVA-PROOF generates valid IVC proof only from legitimate transfer history.
properties.anti_property: Nova proofs can be generated claiming non-existent transfers.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova circuit verifies Merkle proofs against committed roots. Fake transfers fail Merkle verification within circuit. Soundness prevents false claims.

properties.property: The state STATE-USER-HAS-NOVA-PROOF holds locally verifiable IVC proof ready for submission.
properties.anti_property: User believes they have valid proof when proof is invalid.
properties.reachability_rationale: User can locally verify their proof before submission. Invalid proofs fail prover service or on-chain verification. No fund loss risk.

properties.property: The action ACTION-USER-SUBMIT-TO-PROVER transmits IVC proof without revealing user private data.
properties.anti_property: Prover learns user's transaction details or private keys.
properties.reachability_rationale: IVC proof is zero-knowledge - contains no witness data. Prover only sees public inputs (roots, recipient hash). Private transfer amounts/sources not revealed.

properties.property: The state STATE-USER-HAS-GROTH16-PROOF holds proof ready for on-chain verification.
properties.anti_property: Groth16 proof fails on-chain despite successful prover completion.
properties.reachability_rationale: Prover uses same verification key as on-chain verifier. If prover marks job complete with proof, proof will verify on-chain.

properties.property: The action ACTION-USER-SUBMIT-TELEPORT submits proof with correct public inputs matching proof generation.
properties.anti_property: Mismatched public inputs cause valid proof to fail.
properties.reachability_rationale: User can submit mismatched inputs. However, this is user error not security vulnerability. Proof simply fails verification. No fund loss.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-ROTATE-VERIFIERS is only callable by admin during emergency.
properties.anti_property: Verifier rotation possible in non-emergency state or by non-admin.
properties.reachability_rationale: setVerifiers() has onlyOwner modifier and checks isEmergency flag. Both conditions required.

properties.property: The action ACTION-VERIFIER-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY resets emergency state only after verifier rotation.
properties.anti_property: Emergency deactivation without addressing root cause.
properties.reachability_rationale: deactivateEmergency() checks that verifier addresses differ from emergency-triggering configuration. Must rotate before deactivation.

properties.property: The state STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED guarantees new verifier configuration is active.
properties.anti_property: Recovery complete with compromised verifiers still active.
properties.reachability_rationale: Path to STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED requires ACTION-VERIFIER-ROTATE-VERIFIERS which updates verifier addresses.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP validates all wrap parameters before entering trusted LiquidityManager context.
properties.anti_property: Malicious wrap requests can bypass input validation at trust boundary.
properties.reachability_rationale: LiquidityManager.wrap() validates: amount > 0, sender != address(0), safeTransferFrom succeeds. All untrusted inputs validated before state change.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-REWARD uses immutable incentive parameters for reward computation.
properties.anti_property: Parameters can be modified mid-transaction affecting reward.
properties.reachability_rationale: Incentive parameters (k, T) are immutable after deployment. No setter functions exist for these values.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-LM-PULLS-LIQUIDITY uses safeTransferFrom preventing reentrancy and ensuring transfer completion.
properties.anti_property: Reentrancy during transfer allows double-minting.
properties.reachability_rationale: OpenZeppelin SafeERC20 handles reentrancy. Transfer completes before function returns. State follows checks-effects-interactions.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-LM-MINTS-ZERC20 mints exact amount + reward with no rounding errors.
properties.anti_property: Rounding errors accumulate causing supply/backing mismatch.
properties.reachability_rationale: IncentiveLib uses safe math. Floor rounding for rewards means protocol never overpays. Exact arithmetic in uint256.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-WRAP-COMPLETE emits Wrapped event only after all operations succeed.
properties.anti_property: Event emitted without complete wrap execution.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emission is final statement in wrap(). Any prior failure reverts entire transaction including event.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20 transfers tokens from trusted to untrusted domain only after wrap completion.
properties.anti_property: User receives zERC20 without underlying deposit.
properties.reachability_rationale: EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20 is only reachable from STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE which requires prior successful liquidity pull.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP validates user zERC20 balance and amount parameters.
properties.anti_property: Unwrap proceeds with insufficient balance.
properties.reachability_rationale: ERC20._burn checks balance >= amount. LiquidityManager.unwrap() burns before transferring underlying.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-FEE computes fee with ceiling rounding protecting protocol.
properties.anti_property: Fee undercomputation allows value extraction.
properties.reachability_rationale: IncentiveLib.getUnwrapFee uses ceiling division. Protocol always receives at least correct fee.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-LM-BURNS-ZERC20 executes burn before any underlying transfer.
properties.anti_property: Underlying released while zERC20 still exists.
properties.reachability_rationale: Code order: burn() called before safeTransfer(). EVM sequential execution ensures burn completes first.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-LM-TRANSFERS-UNDERLYING transfers exact (amount - fee) using SafeERC20.
properties.anti_property: Transfer amount differs from (amount - fee).
properties.reachability_rationale: Transfer amount computed as amount - fee. No modification between computation and transfer call.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE emits Unwrapped event with accurate amounts.
properties.anti_property: Event amounts differ from actual transfer.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event uses same computed values as transfer. Single transaction ensures consistency.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-UNWRAP-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY reverts before any state changes.
properties.anti_property: Partial unwrap with burned tokens but no underlying transfer.
properties.reachability_rationale: Liquidity check occurs before burn. Revert rolls back any partial state changes.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING completes after successful underlying transfer.
properties.anti_property: State indicates user has underlying without actual transfer.
properties.reachability_rationale: safeTransfer reverts on failure. State transition only on successful transfer.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER validates value <= 2^248-1 before processing.
properties.anti_property: Value exceeding field limit enters hash chain.
properties.reachability_rationale: _afterTokenTransfer hook validates value. Transfer reverts if value > MAX_VALUE. Hash chain never contains invalid values.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-ZERC20-VALIDATES-VALUE enforces strict comparison value <= 2^248-1.
properties.anti_property: Off-by-one error in comparison allows 2^248.
properties.reachability_rationale: Constant MAX_VALUE = 2^248 - 1. Comparison is value <= MAX_VALUE. Semantically correct.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-VALUE-TOO-LARGE reverts with ValueTooLarge error for tracking.
properties.anti_property: Rejection without informative error.
properties.reachability_rationale: Custom error ValueTooLarge is defined and used. Provides clear failure reason.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-BALANCES performs atomic balance updates.
properties.anti_property: Sender debited without recipient credited or vice versa.
properties.reachability_rationale: OpenZeppelin ERC20._transfer is atomic. Both balance updates in same storage operation batch.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-HASH-CHAIN appends deterministic SHA-256 hash matching Nova circuit.
properties.anti_property: Hash chain format differs from Nova circuit expectation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hash computation: SHA256(prevHash || to || value) truncated to 248 bits. Matches Nova circuit implementation exactly.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-ZERC20-EMITS-EVENT emits IndexedTransfer with monotonic index.
properties.anti_property: Index skips values or duplicates.
properties.reachability_rationale: Index uses post-increment (index++). Sequential execution ensures no skips or duplicates.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE represents successful atomic completion of transfer.
properties.anti_property: Partial transfer state persists.
properties.reachability_rationale: EVM atomic transactions. Either all operations complete or all revert.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-INDEXER-WATCHES monitors only authorized zERC20 contract events.
properties.anti_property: Indexer processes events from spoofed contracts.
properties.reachability_rationale: Indexer configured with contract addresses. Even if spoofed events indexed, Merkle proofs fail on-chain verification.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-INDEXER-EVENT-RECEIVED processes events from trusted zERC20 into semi-trusted indexer.
properties.anti_property: Event processing alters event data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Indexer processes events. Alterations produce invalid Merkle proofs detectable on-chain.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-INDEXER-TREE-UPDATED maintains Merkle tree consistent with on-chain state.
properties.anti_property: Tree diverges from on-chain hash chain.
properties.reachability_rationale: Divergent trees produce invalid proofs. Users can verify proofs against on-chain roots.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-INDEXER-GENERATES-PROOF produces valid Merkle inclusion proofs.
properties.anti_property: Generated proofs fail verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: Invalid proofs fail ZK circuit. Users detect and report indexer issues.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-VERIFIER-RESERVES-CHECKPOINT creates immutable binding between index and hash chain.
properties.anti_property: Checkpoint can be modified after creation.
properties.reachability_rationale: reservedHashChains mapping has no update function. Only write path is initial reservation.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-CHECKPOINT-RESERVED emits HashChainReserved event matching stored data.
properties.anti_property: Event and storage values differ.
properties.reachability_rationale: Same values used for storage and event emission in same transaction.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-AWAITING-NOVA-PROOF requires prior checkpoint reservation.
properties.anti_property: Proof submission for non-reserved index.
properties.reachability_rationale: proveTransferRoot checks reservedHashChains[index] != 0. Missing checkpoint causes revert.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED validates cryptographic proof from untrusted user.
properties.anti_property: Invalid proofs accepted for transfer root storage.
properties.reachability_rationale: On-chain Groth16 verifier cryptographically validates proof. Soundness prevents forgery.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-VALID stores root only after successful verification.
properties.anti_property: Root stored before verification completes.
properties.reachability_rationale: Control flow: verify() returns before storage write. Failed verify() reverts transaction.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-DIVERGENT-PROOF-DETECTED triggers emergency only on actual divergence.
properties.anti_property: Emergency triggered falsely without divergence.
properties.reachability_rationale: Check: provedTransferRoots[index] != 0 AND provedTransferRoots[index] != newRoot. Both valid proofs required for divergence detection.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-VERIFIER-RELAYS-ROOT only relays cryptographically proven roots.
properties.anti_property: Unproven roots transmitted to Hub.
properties.reachability_rationale: relayTransferRoot reads from provedTransferRoots which only populated after proof verification.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-ROOT-RELAYED confirms LayerZero message submission.
properties.anti_property: Relay claimed successful without actual submission.
properties.reachability_rationale: _lzSend reverts on failure. Transition only reached on successful submission.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT validates sender EID matches registered Verifier.
properties.anti_property: Roots from unauthorized EIDs stored.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hub._lzReceive validates srcEid against registered verifier EIDs. Invalid EID causes revert.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-HUB-UPDATES-ROOT updates transferRoots after sender validation.
properties.anti_property: Update occurs before validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Control flow: validation check precedes storage write.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-ROOT-STORED emits TransferRootUpdated matching stored value.
properties.anti_property: Event/storage mismatch.
properties.reachability_rationale: Same values for storage and event in same transaction.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-AWAITING-BROADCAST maintains readiness for broadcast trigger.
properties.anti_property: Broadcast blocked indefinitely.
properties.reachability_rationale: Broadcast is permissionless. Anyone can trigger. Delay is availability issue not security.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-BROADCAST-TRIGGERED initiates aggregation computation.
properties.anti_property: Broadcast triggered with empty roots.
properties.reachability_rationale: Empty broadcast wastes gas but doesn't affect security. Produces valid (empty) aggregation.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-AGGREGATION-COMPUTED produces deterministic PoseidonT3 tree.
properties.anti_property: Non-deterministic aggregation results.
properties.reachability_rationale: PoseidonT3 is deterministic hash function. Same inputs always produce same tree.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-AGG-SEQ-INCREMENTED maintains strictly monotonic sequence.
properties.anti_property: Sequence can repeat or decrease.
properties.reachability_rationale: Unchecked increment only. No decrement or reset operations.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SENT broadcasts same root to all registered Verifiers.
properties.anti_property: Different Verifiers receive different roots.
properties.reachability_rationale: Message payload constructed once, sent to all destinations in loop.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL validates Hub EID before storing.
properties.anti_property: Global roots from unauthorized sources stored.
properties.reachability_rationale: Verifier._lzReceive checks srcEid == hubEid. Invalid source causes revert.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED stores root in globalTransferRoots after validation.
properties.anti_property: Storage before validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Control flow enforces validation before storage.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-USER-GENERATES-STEALTH initiates client-side privacy operation.
properties.anti_property: Stealth generation leaks user identity.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stealth generation is local client operation. No network communication during generation.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-STEALTH-GENERATED produces cryptographically bound stealth address.
properties.anti_property: Stealth address not bound to recipient.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stealth address derived from recipient via Poseidon hash. Cryptographic binding to GeneralRecipient.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-GENERATED produces proof only from valid transfer history.
properties.anti_property: Proof generated for non-existent transfers.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova circuit verifies Merkle proofs against committed roots. Invalid transfers fail circuit.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TO-PROVER transmits only public proof data.
properties.anti_property: Private witness data sent to prover.
properties.reachability_rationale: IVC proof contains commitments only. Private witness stays client-side.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-PROVER-RECEIVES-IVC processes untrusted user input with validation.
properties.anti_property: Malformed IVC causes prover corruption.
properties.reachability_rationale: Prover deserializes and validates IVC. Malformed input causes job failure, not corruption. Prover is stateless per job.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-JOB-QUEUED maintains job ordering for fair processing.
properties.anti_property: Jobs can jump queue.
properties.reachability_rationale: Queue fairness is service quality, not security. Priority games don't affect proof validity.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-JOB-STARTS-PROCESSING begins isolated proof computation.
properties.anti_property: Jobs interfere with each other.
properties.reachability_rationale: Each job runs in isolated context with own proving key. No shared mutable state.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-PROVER-CONVERTS uses correct proving key for circuit type.
properties.anti_property: Wrong proving key produces invalid proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Prover loads proving key matching circuit type from IVC header. Mismatch causes proving failure.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-JOB-COMPLETED returns valid Groth16 proof.
properties.anti_property: Completed job returns invalid proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Prover uses same verification key as on-chain. Proof verified locally before returning.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-JOB-FAILED returns error status without proof data.
properties.anti_property: Partial proof returned on failure.
properties.reachability_rationale: Job status indicates failure. No proof field populated on failure.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-USER-RETRIEVES-GROTH16 delivers proof without modification.
properties.anti_property: Proof altered during retrieval.
properties.reachability_rationale: User verifies retrieved proof locally before submission. Altered proof fails verification.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT submits proof with matching public inputs.
properties.anti_property: Mismatched inputs cause valid proof rejection.
properties.reachability_rationale: Mismatched inputs are user error. Proof fails verification. No security impact.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT validates all untrusted parameters.
properties.anti_property: Malicious teleport parameters bypass validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Four-layer validation: root reference, recipient hash, monotonicity, proof verification. All must pass.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-VALIDATE-ROOT-REF checks root in proved or global roots mapping.
properties.anti_property: Arbitrary roots accepted.
properties.reachability_rationale: Mapping lookup returns 0 for unknown roots. Zero root fails comparison.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH binds proof to msg.sender.
properties.anti_property: Proof usable by non-intended recipient.
properties.reachability_rationale: recipientHash = Poseidon(chain_id, msg.sender, tweak). Different sender produces different hash.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-CHECK-MONOTONICITY enforces strictly increasing totalTeleported.
properties.anti_property: Same proof usable multiple times.
properties.reachability_rationale: Require newTotal > currentTotal. Replay has newTotal <= currentTotal, fails check.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF cryptographically verifies proof.
properties.anti_property: Invalid proofs pass verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: On-chain Groth16 verifier. Soundness ensures forged proofs fail.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-PROOF-VALID-CALL-TELEPORT mints exact delta from proof.
properties.anti_property: Minted amount differs from proof delta.
properties.reachability_rationale: Delta extracted from verified public inputs. Passed directly to teleport().

properties.property: The transition EDGE-TELEPORT-MINTED completes with Teleport event emission.
properties.anti_property: Minting without event.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emission in zERC20.teleport() after successful mint.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-INVALID-ROOT reverts with clear error.
properties.anti_property: Rejection without error context.
properties.reachability_rationale: Custom error RootNotFound provides context for failure.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-BAD-RECIPIENT reverts on hash mismatch.
properties.anti_property: Mismatched recipient proceeds.
properties.reachability_rationale: Strict equality check on recipient hash. Mismatch reverts.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-DOUBLE-SPEND prevents replay attacks.
properties.anti_property: Replay succeeds.
properties.reachability_rationale: totalTeleported monotonicity check fails on replay.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-INVALID-PROOF rejects cryptographically invalid proofs.
properties.anti_property: Invalid proofs accepted.
properties.reachability_rationale: Groth16 verification fails for invalid proofs. Revert on failure.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-USER-INITIATES-BRIDGE validates user balance before proceeding.
properties.anti_property: Bridge initiated without sufficient balance.
properties.reachability_rationale: Adaptor calls LiquidityManager.unwrap() which validates balance.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-ADAPTOR-RECEIVES-REQUEST validates bridge parameters.
properties.anti_property: Invalid bridge parameters accepted.
properties.reachability_rationale: Parameter validation before any state changes.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-ADAPTOR-UNWRAPS delegates to LiquidityManager.
properties.anti_property: Bypass of LiquidityManager validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Adaptor calls LiquidityManager.unwrap() directly. No bypass exists.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES enforces slippage limits.
properties.anti_property: Bridge executes with excessive slippage.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stargate bridge enforces minAmountOut. Slippage exceeds limit triggers revert or refund.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-BRIDGE-INITIATED confirms cross-chain message sent.
properties.anti_property: Bridge initiated without message.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stargate.send() reverts on failure. Event only on success.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-BRIDGE-FAILED triggers refund mechanism.
properties.anti_property: Bridge failure loses funds.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stargate implements refund for failed bridges. User recovers funds.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-EMERGENCY-ROTATE-VERIFIERS requires admin and emergency state.
properties.anti_property: Rotation without proper authorization.
properties.reachability_rationale: onlyOwner modifier + isEmergency check. Both conditions required.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY requires verifier rotation.
properties.anti_property: Deactivation without addressing issue.
properties.reachability_rationale: deactivateEmergency checks verifier addresses changed.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED restores normal operation.
properties.anti_property: Recovery incomplete.
properties.reachability_rationale: isEmergency flag reset. New verifiers active.

properties.property: The transition EDGE-BACK-TO-IDLE completes emergency recovery cycle.
properties.anti_property: Verifier stuck in recovered state.
properties.reachability_rationale: State machine returns to idle after recovery.

properties.property: The state STATE-NOVA-GEN-INIT initializes Nova circuit with correct parameters.
properties.anti_property: Wrong circuit parameters loaded.
properties.reachability_rationale: Parameters loaded from versioned files matching on-chain verifier.

properties.property: The action ACTION-NOVA-FETCH-MERKLE-PROOFS retrieves verifiable proofs from indexer.
properties.anti_property: Invalid proofs accepted for circuit input.
properties.reachability_rationale: Proofs verified within circuit. Invalid proofs cause circuit failure.

properties.property: The action ACTION-NOVA-LOAD-CIRCUIT-PARAMS loads correct proving parameters.
properties.anti_property: Mismatched parameters cause verification failure.
properties.reachability_rationale: Parameters from trusted source, hash-verified against expected values.

properties.property: The action ACTION-NOVA-SETUP-WITNESS prepares witness data from valid transfers.
properties.anti_property: Fake transfer data in witness.
properties.reachability_rationale: Witness verified against Merkle proofs in circuit.

properties.property: The action ACTION-NOVA-FOLD-STEP executes correct folding computation.
properties.anti_property: Folding produces invalid accumulator.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova folding is deterministic. Invalid folding fails verification.

properties.property: The state STATE-NOVA-FOLDING-LOOP accumulates all transfers correctly.
properties.anti_property: Transfers skipped or double-counted.
properties.reachability_rationale: Loop processes each transfer exactly once. State vector tracks progress.

properties.property: The action ACTION-NOVA-FINALIZE-IVC produces valid IVC proof.
properties.anti_property: Finalized proof fails verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: Finalization follows correct protocol. Proof verified locally.

properties.property: The state STATE-NOVA-IVC-COMPLETE holds verifiable IVC proof.
properties.anti_property: Incomplete proof marked complete.
properties.reachability_rationale: State only reached after successful finalization and local verification.
